Problem: Write a function to sort a list of elements using radix sort.

Tests:
assert radix_sort([15, 79, 25, 68, 37]) == [15, 25, 37, 68, 79]
assert radix_sort([9, 11, 8, 7, 3, 2]) == [2, 3, 7, 8, 9, 11]
assert radix_sort([36, 12, 24, 26, 29]) == [12, 24, 26, 29, 36]

Write the t task named `radix_sort` with 1 parameter(s) of type(s) seq, in the order the tests pass them, returning seq. The tests must pass and the ensures must specify the result.
